summary: Frontend-only audit of the day/night theme. A reusable in-page checker (/app/tests/theme_audit.js) looks for pure white/black backgrounds, the old navy #0A192F/#0B1736 (as a background colour or inside a background image), text contrast (WCAG 4.5:1, or 3:1 for large text) against the composited effective background, input text contrast and placeholder contrast. It was run on every requested page in both modes at 1440x900 and 375x812: public pages, the doctor area (Oggi, Pazienti, patient folder, passport, Messaggi, Cassa, Impostazioni, Strumenti, consultation overlay, profile menu, tour) and the parent portal (6 sections and the bell dropdown). What works: the toggle switches the theme instantly and the icon and aria-label change between moon and sun. The choice is saved in localStorage 'mantmed.theme' and still applies after a reload and on other pages (/app -> /app/cassa -> /). On a first visit with localStorage cleared, the theme follows prefers-color-scheme in both directions. Exactly one theme-toggle-btn is present on /, /app, /portale, /registrati/medico, /registrati/paziente, /privacy, /verifica, /reimposta-password, /attiva, the doctor TopBar and the portal header. The top bar (sidebar, sidebar-tablet) and the mobile bottom-nav use --bar (#0F1A1E day, #16282E night) with #F7F9FB text. No pure white or black backgrounds were found anywhere. The Oggi agenda shows 'Allergia: Amoxicillina (rash cutaneo)', 'Allergia: Acari della polvere' and 'Allergia: Nichel' (oggi-visit-allergy-<id>). Many contrast failures remain. The most serious: the consultation patient-name input is unreadable in both modes, the night-mode notification bell has unread rows that cannot be read, and all of the --accent surfaces in night mode fail contrast, with the whole consultation overlay turning light teal.

ui_bugs.issue: Typed text cannot be read in both modes. Day: #F7F9FB text on #E4EAEC, ratio 1.15. Night: #0F1A1E text on #22343B, ratio 1.37. The placeholder is also around 1.1-1.3. Root cause: in theme.css the rule input:not([type=checkbox]):not([type=radio]):not([type=range]){background-color:var(--raised)} has specificity 0,3,1, which beats Tailwind's bg-transparent. The input sits inside .bg-[var(--accent)], so it gets text-[var(--ink)] on a --raised background. The same override hits every input that is meant to be transparent.
The 'Visita libera: confermo di aver acquisito il consenso…' block appears after typing a name. Its text contrast is about 1.2 in both modes.

Unread rows use bg-sky-50/60, which renders as light grey #9AA5AA in night mode. The title (#EEF2F4) is at ratio 2.25 and the meta and time text (#A3B1B8) at 1.15, so they cannot be read. File: components/portal/NotificationBell.jsx:26. The icon circles bg-sky-100 and bg-violet-100 are also leftover light blue and violet.

In night mode, .bg-[var(--accent)] sets --fg2 to color-mix(ink 78%), which gives #24353B on #6E95A1 at ratio 3.93. Affected: the whole consultation overlay (consultation-overlay, consultation-setup, mantai-info-btn, consult-template-picker, consult-template-manage, template chips), the tour card (tour-step-1, tour-skip-btn, tour-progress, tour-body), cash-summary on /app/cassa, the patient-folder header 'Cartella clinica', and on the home page hero-mock and feature-trascrizione. tour-video-expand 'Schermo intero' is at 1.22. Separately, in night mode the full-screen consultation overlay and the tour card turn light teal, which looks like an inverted theme rather than the night palette.

'Allergia: X' uses --alert #A9452F on --alert-bg over the surface, ratio 3.85, which is below 4.5. --alert also fails directly on --bg (3.77) and on --surface (4.38). Affected: oggi-visit-allergy-<id>, oggi-legend, the 'Allergie' chip on patient-card-<id>, profile-logout 'Esci' (4.39), and reset-error and activate-error on the login card (3.16). Night mode passes.

#3F7D5C fails on the day surfaces at about 3.0-3.3. Affected: doc-thread-status-<id> and thread-status-<id> 'Risposto', docs-signed-status-<id> 'Valido', portal-checkpoint-<id> 'ottimo', passport-consent-badge (3.33), and the login hints 'Formato email valido' and 'Lunghezza adeguata' on the login card (about 2.6). Fix: darken day --ok to about #2F6447.

The login, registration and activate cards use bg-[var(--sel)] over --bg, which composites to #B5C0C4. --fg2 #44525E on that is 4.32. Affected: login-note, the EMAIL and PASSWORD labels, every label in register-doctor-form and register-parent-form, activate-page eyebrow, and register-doctor-btn and register-parent-btn subtitles on the home page. Nested --sel in the portal: portal-simple-todo and portal-simple-when are at 3.64 and portal-simple-box at 4.32.
The placeholder ratio is about 2.1. Affected: team-search-input and passport-search-input on /app/pazienti, specialists-search-input, account-fiscal-code and account-address.

issues: The specialist card cover uses radial-gradient #1E3A5F to #0A192F in components/portal/SpecialistsDirectory.jsx:11 (specialist-card-*).
The DoctorShowcase cover fallback uses the same navy gradient in components/showcase/ShowcaseView.jsx:29 (/medico/tiziana-foti, both modes). That page also has no theme toggle.

Leftover light-blue badges 'bg-sky-100 text-sky-900': Portal.jsx:41 and AreaTabs.jsx:20 (checkpoint 'buono'), Conversation.jsx:9 ('Letto'), ReplyQueue.jsx:10 ('Amministrativo'), plus the NotificationBell icons. TeamState.jsx uses bg-violet-50 with text-violet-900.

The BodychartEditor carry-over button uses bg-[#F0FDF4] with text-[var(--fg)] (BodychartEditor.jsx:176). In night mode that is near-white text on a near-white background. Not seen at runtime because it needs a previous bodychart; confirmed from the code.
The guided tour video area is a large white rectangle in both modes (video, poster or background missing).
Mobile TopBar at 375: the theme toggle sits inside the doctor-chip pill and looks cramped.

action_items: Fix the global input background rule in theme.css, for example wrap it in :where(), so bg-transparent and other bg-* classes win. Then fix consult-free-name-input and consent-gate-free text colours in both modes.
NotificationBell.jsx: replace bg-sky-50/60 on unread rows with var(--sel) or a variant of it, and replace the sky and violet icon circles with tokens.

Night mode: for .bg-[var(--accent)], use a darker --fg2 mix (about 92% ink, or plain ink) so it reaches 4.5:1. Reconsider whether the full-screen consultation overlay and the tour card should use --accent in night mode at all; --bar or --surface would fit the palette better.
Day mode: darken --alert (about #8E3522) so 'Allergia: X' reaches 4.5:1 on --alert-bg over --surface and on the --sel cards, and darken --ok (about #2F6447).
Day mode: raise contrast of --fg2 on the --sel cards (login, registration, activate, home register buttons, nested portal-simple boxes), for example a darker --fg2 or a lighter card background.
Replace the navy gradient covers in SpecialistsDirectory.jsx:11 and ShowcaseView.jsx:29, the leftover bg-sky-100 and bg-violet badges, and bg-[#F0FDF4] in BodychartEditor.jsx with theme tokens.
Optional: add a ThemeToggle to /medico/:slug and give the tour video area a themed background.
critical_code_review_comments: theme.css line 104: the input:not(...) background rule has higher specificity than Tailwind utilities, so it silently overrides bg-transparent and other bg-* classes on inputs.
The --fg2 override for .bg-[var(--accent)] uses color-mix at 78% ink. That passes in day mode but gives 3.93 in night mode.

/reimposta-password and /attiva without a token show 'Connessione non riuscita: verifichi la rete e riprovi' instead of a 'link non valido' message. This is a logic and wording issue, not a theme issue.
updated_files: /app/tests/theme_audit.js (new test helper; no app code changed)

success_rate.frontend: about 60% (toggle, persistence, first-visit system theme, nav bar colours, allergy labels and no pure white/black all pass; many contrast and leftover-colour failures)

seed_data_creation: None. Only a free-name 'TEST_Mario Rossi' was typed in the consultation overlay, which was closed without starting a visit. No registrations were submitted.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use /app/tests/theme_audit.js in browser_automation: AUDIT=open('/app/tests/theme_audit.js').read(); r=await page.evaluate(AUDIT). It returns white, black, navy and lowc lists. Set the theme with localStorage.setItem('mantmed.theme', mode) and reload. Log in by pressing Enter in login-password-input (there is no login-submit-btn testid). Use networkidle only for the first page; use wait_until='load' afterwards. The consultation overlay opens via oggi-next-start-btn and closes via consultation-close-btn. No toast was triggered by passport-sync-btn, so toast styling was only checked in the CSS.
